Posts to a mailbox (contactListId set) belong to the mailbox's members and are left out unless includeListPosts is true or a contactListId is given.

service.description: What the record link and timeline services know about a record type: the full entity name and its single primary key field, the record's own communication event join and work effort join (null when the generic CommunicationEventRecord or WorkEffortRecord holds its links; a party's own communication event link is the event's from and to party and its CommunicationEventParty rows), its note entity and its content entity. With checkRecord (the default) the record must be found under the user's filters.

parameter.name: recordTypeName
parameter.description: The entity name in words, such as Order Header

service.description: The CommunicationEvent of a framework EmailMessage (by emailMessageId), created when there is none: type Email, the from and to party matched by the user account or by an email address on a party (the first To address), the status from the message's, and the parent event of the message's parent email when it has one.

Files a communication event on a record. The link is the record's own join when it has one (OrderCommunicationEvent, RequestCommEvent, WorkEffortCommEvent, WikiPageCommunicationEvent). For a party it is the event's from or to party, or the party's CommunicationEventParty row, written with role _NA_ (Not Applicable: a party the event is about, not a recipient) when the party has none. Any other record gets a CommunicationEventRecord. Linking again changes nothing. The event is communicationEventId, or the event of a framework email (emailMessageId), created when there is none. With notifyFollowers a new link notifies the record's followers of messages (of notes for a Comment).

parameter.name: recordUrl
parameter.description: The record's screen, for the follower notification's link

parameter.name: created
parameter.description: True when this call wrote the link

service.description: Removes a communication event from a record: the own join row, the CommunicationEventRecord, or for a party the _NA_ CommunicationEventParty row. A party the event is from or to, or a recipient of, stays linked.

parameter.name: unlinked
parameter.description: True when a link row was removed

service.description:
The history of a record, newest first: its communication events (messages; a Comment is a note) through the own join or CommunicationEventRecord with the replies in their threads, and for a party those it is from, to or a party to (find#PartyCommunicationEvents, mailbox posts left out unless includeListPosts); its *Note rows as notes (PartyNote, WorkEffortNote, RequestNote, OrderNote, FacilityNote); its done activities (work efforts with the purpose WepPhoneCall, WepEmail, WepToDo or WepMeeting through RequestWorkEffort, WikiPageWorkEffort or WorkEffortRecord); its changes from the entity audit log; and its files (the *Content rows). The open activities come apart in plannedActivities, soonest due first, with the assignee.
kinds limits the entries to messages, notes, activities, changes and files (a list or comma-separated text; empty is all). Page with pageIndex and pageSize, or give beforeDate (the date of the last entry shown) for the entries before it.
Each source stands alone: one that fails is logged by name and left out, and its name is in failedSources. The services of the ServiceRegister rows of type RecordTimelineSource are sources too: each gets recordEntityName, recordId, kinds (the wanted entry kinds), beforeDate and limit, and returns entryList.
An entry is {kind (message, note, activity, change or file), date, authorPartyId, authorUserId, title, body, contentType, statusId, source (the entity or service it came from)} with the fields of its kind: communicationEventId, communicationEventTypeId, fromPartyId, toPartyId, parentCommEventId, rootCommEventId, emailMessageId, contactListId and attachments (the CommunicationEventContent rows) for a message or a Comment note; noteDate and internalNote for a *Note row; workEffortId and purposeEnumId for an activity; auditHistorySeqId, fieldName, oldValue, newValue, oldValueDescription and newValueDescription (status descriptions) and changeReason for a change; contentKey, contentLocation and contentTypeEnumId for a file.

parameter.name: kinds
parameter.description: A list or comma-separated: messages, notes, activities, changes, files

service.description: Chatter's Log note: a Comment communication event from the user (create#Message), filed on the record (link#CommunicationEventRecord). The users mentioned are notified on topic ChatterMention, and the record's followers of notes on topic RecordFollow, leaving out the author and those mentioned. A failed notification is logged; the note stays.

parameter.name: parentCommEventId
parameter.description: The note or message this answers

parameter.name: recordUrl
parameter.description: The record's screen, for the notifications' link

service.description: Notifies the users mentioned in a note or message on a record, on topic ChatterMention: mentionUserIds and the users of mentionPartyIds, less the author. The message has recordEntityName, recordId, recordName, communicationEventId, authorUserId, authorName, subject and summary; the link is recordUrl, since the record's screen belongs to the app. A failed send is logged and notifies no one.

Notifies the followers of a record whose RecordFollower row has the kind on (notifyMessages, notifyNotes, notifyActivities, notifyChanges), on topic RecordFollow, less the author and excludeUserIds. The message is that of notify#RecordMention plus kind and workEffortId. A failed send is logged and notifies no one.
The message of a mention or follower notification: the record, its name in words with its id, the author's name, the subject, and a summary (the subject, or the start of the body as text).

The user (by default the current one) follows a record. kinds (a list or comma-separated: messages, notes, activities, changes) sets which notify, the others off; without it a new follower gets messages, notes and activities, and an existing one keeps its kinds. Following again updates the kinds.
The followers of a record, each with the user's name and party and which kinds notify; isFollowing for the current user.
